_contract: The finite bucket of splice behaviors (NOTATION_ARCHITECTURE.md §3). Keyed by strategy name; classes reference these by name. New strategies are decisions with a journal line. Versioned; v0 = the five from the composer's day-19 dictation.

strategies.name: matisse-cut
strategies.behavior: clip geometry at the boundary; both sides keep identity; continuous data re-reads from S1 on each side

strategies.name: cursor-jump-continuous-delta
strategies.behavior: runtime object jumps to new x,y and a new loop at the splice; the TIME delta stays continuous across the visual break

strategies.name: stamp-atomic
strategies.behavior: a glyph group is never cut; the boundary moves or the stamp moves, the stamp does not split

strategies.name: bars-prefer-chunk-boundaries
strategies.behavior: cuts land at chunk starts wherever possible (the M5 chunk is the atom of the strip, PLAN §7 amendment); a cut breaking a beam group is last resort and must be marked in the render

strategies.name: page-edge-rules
strategies.behavior: clamp/move decision tree stored as RULES, not baked positions (P6 at layout level); per-class, upgrading piece #2's whole-object-only PL-2
